articles.title: US Embassy in Israel issues security alert over Iranian and Houthi threats
articles.description: The US Embassy in Jerusalem urges Americans to exercise heightened vigilance amid Iranian and Houthi threats, warning of potential flight cancellations.
articles.content: The US Embassy in Jerusalem issued a security alert on Tuesday, urging American citizens in Israel and throughout the Middle East to exercise heightened vigilance amid an increased threat of attacks … [+2954 chars]
